source.prompt: Seamless tileable texture, square, 2048x2048. Orthographic top-down view, a flat, front-on decorative panel filling the whole frame edge to edge. Flat, even, shadowless lighting, as if scanned: no highlights, no vignette, no shading gradient across the image. No perspective, no objects, no text, no border, no watermark. The left edge must continue into the right edge and the top into the bottom. Material: Arctic Yup'ik and Chukchi waterproof sea-mammal gutskin kamleika parchment at 28 cm garment scale: five horizontal translucent warm amber-ochre membrane strips (#c89448 to #e0c48e) whip-stitched horizontally with dark braided sinew (#221c18) and punctuated every 4 cm by tiny tufts of dyed crimson (#9a2420) and slate (#3c4856) qiviut yarn caught in the waterproof seams, subtle natural collagen crinkle grain. Full colour.
